_tiersComment: FROZEN — HANDOFF rule 1, with one owner-requested change. On 2026-11-07 the owner asked for a rule-matching pass so the website says exactly what the members system (members.worththedrivegolf.com, wtd-members src/config/defaults.js) enforces. That pass replaced the old freeze line ('Do not add priority windows, holds, peak definitions, or new guest fees') and changed: $100 hours to weekdays midnight-5 PM; $150 from 24/7 to off-peak; guests stated per booking; fixed 1/2/3-hour tee times replaced by 30-minute increments up to 4 hours; active-booking limits 1/1/2/2 changed to 2/2/4/4; booking windows added (1/1/2/2 weeks); Corporate users 2-3 changed to 2 and guests 4 changed to 3; buddy add-on added; the Weekday 2-hour buddy-block line removed. Prices stay configurable data: `price` is the month-to-month list price in whole dollars. `commitMonthly`, `commitYear`, `pifYear`, `founderPrice`, `buddyAdd` and `guestFee` are derived the same way the members system's pricing.quote() derives them (12-month plan = 11 months spread over 12 payments, rounded down to the cent with the last payment absorbing the remainder; paid in full = 10 months; Founders = 25% off `price`; buddy add-on = 33% of `price`). If a price changes in the members admin, update these fields to match /api/public/plans. Frozen otherwise: change values only when the members system changes. Removing `buddyAdd` hides the buddy line for that tier.

_memberRulesComment: Added 2026-11-07. One-line statements of the members system's booking and membership rules, used in FAQs and summary cards so every page says the same thing. Numbers are the members system's defaults (configurable in its admin); keep these in step with it and with wtd-members src/documents/membership-terms.md.

memberRules.peak: Peak hours are weekdays 5–10 PM and all day Saturday and Sunday.
memberRules.booking: Book in 30-minute increments, from 30 minutes up to 4 hours per booking.
memberRules.windows: Book up to 1 week ahead on Weekday and Full, 2 weeks on Premier and Corporate, and 3 weeks as a Founder.
memberRules.limits: Hold up to 2 upcoming bookings on Weekday and Full, 4 on Premier and Corporate, and 6 as a Founder (no more than 2 in peak hours). Limits are shared by your household.
memberRules.household: One household, one bay at a time. If another bay is still empty within 15 minutes of its start time, your household can claim it for up to an hour.
memberRules.guests: Guests are per booking. Weekday Members bring up to 3 guests at $10 each. Full Members get 1 guest free, with extra guests at $10 each, up to 3. Premier Members and the Corporate Club bring up to 3 guests free.
memberRules.guestList: Every guest must be on your booking — by name, or as “Guest 1” and “Guest 2” if you'd rather not say. Guest fees are charged when you book, and guests come in with you.
memberRules.buddy: Add a buddy or spouse for 33% of your tier's base price, split between you — Premier for two is $266 a month, or $133 each. Each of you gets your own door code, signs your own waiver and pays your own half, and nothing starts until both of you have signed and paid. Not available on the Corporate Club.
memberRules.buddyLeave: If one of you leaves, the other keeps full access for 30 days at their half rate, then switches to a solo membership or cancels. A replacement buddy can step in and take over the remaining months.
memberRules.door: When you join, the system creates your own 6-digit door code. It works right away and stays on once you've done your in-person walkthrough within 30 days. Your code is personal — never share it.
memberRules.signup: Sign the waiver online, pay securely, and you're approved straight away — no application to wait on.
memberRules.grace: If a payment fails, it's retried automatically and you keep full access for at least 24 hours while you update your card.
memberRules.cancel: Cancel a booking any time before it starts. Month-to-month memberships can be cancelled any time; on a 12-month plan, the rest of the commitment is still owed if you leave early.
memberRules.anytime: The Studio never closes: Premier and Corporate members can book any hour, and Weekday and Full members book the off-peak hours their plan includes.

aiSwing._source: ProTee VX Swing A.I. Trainer (ProTee also write it AI Swing Trainer), powered by GolfSwings.ai, inside ProTee Labs. Two included swing cameras, full-body tracking, an instructional video paired with each point it raises, no extra subscription. In public beta as of August 2026 — say so.
aiSwing.heading: Something watching every swing
aiSwing.lead: Launch monitors tell you what the ball did. The Swing A.I. Trainer looks at what you did — two cameras track your whole body through the swing, not just the club, and the analysis points at the specific thing costing you shots.

points.title: Your whole body, not just the club
points.body: Two swing cameras come with the VX and record from two angles at once, so the analysis sees your actual motion rather than inferring it from the clubhead.

points.title: It finds the fault
points.body: The analysis identifies where your swing is losing you shots, instead of handing you twenty numbers and leaving you to work out which one matters.

points.title: Then it shows you the fix
points.body: Each point it raises comes paired with an instructional video showing what to work on and how to make the change.

aiSwing.note: The Swing A.I. Trainer is in public beta from ProTee and improving continuously. It runs inside ProTee Labs with no extra subscription, and it is included with studio access — every tier, no upcharge.
